SELECT f.id, f.room_type_id as roomTypeId, rt.type_name as typeName, rt.price, rt.bed_type as bedType, rti.image_url as mainImage FROM favorite f LEFT JOIN room_type rt ON f.room_type_id = rt.id
LEFT JOIN room_type_image rti ON rt.id = rti.room_type_id AND rti.is_main = 1 WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
